lmcache 0.5.5 in the upstream vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0 base image; unauthenticated ZeroMQ ROUTER socket in LMCache multiprocess (distributed) mode. Needs framework owner review to decide between accepting the grpcio downgrade and waiting for upstream lmcache to relax the pin.
